messages:
Rhea: Heads-up: Finance flagged a small but persistent billing delta tied to the marketplace grace window. Seems like usage arriving exactly at the grace boundary got billed in some regions. Can we sanity-check entitlements/hold logic?
Oliver: Which partner and what grace window?
Rhea: partner_id=314, launch_grace_window_hours=48, customers onboarded during private launch. Issue shows up for events with posted_ts == embargo_release_ts - looks like a > vs >= bug.
Samir: I can look at the entitlement checker. Our code applies hold if now < embargo_release_ts, but when clocks round to seconds some clients post at the same second and boundary comparison flipped.
BillingBot: Alert: 126 events potentially billed at boundary across APAC and EU between 2026-06-14T15:00:00Z and 2026-06-14T15:00:20Z. Estimated exposure $420.
MarketplaceEng: Confirmed: entitlement_hold evaluates as (posted_ts < release_ts). Some downstream pipelines normalize posted_ts to epoch seconds; our reconciler used millisecond precision. That mismatch caused a few events to miss the hold.
Rhea: Ok — mitigation plan? We need to avoid customer-impacting invoices and produce a reconciliation plan for those affected.
Oliver: Short-term: retroactively tag events that occurred within 1s of release_ts with hold:embargo-314 and mark as non-billable, then run credit job for customers billed.
Samir: I'll patch the check to compare using normalized UTC millis and add a unit test for boundary conditions. PR incoming.
LegalBot: Legal asks for an audit CSV showing affected customers and confirmation that no invoices were sent to partners before credits applied.
Rhea: I'll pull the ledger snapshot and attach. Can you paste the query you'll use to find suspect events?
Samir: Query I used:
```sql
SELECT e.event_id, e.customer_id, e.posted_ts, l.billed_amount, e.launch_id
FROM partner_events e
LEFT JOIN ledger_lines l ON l.source_event_id = e.event_id
WHERE e.partner_id = 314
  AND e.launch_id = 'embargo-314'
  AND e.posted_ts BETWEEN '2026-06-14T15:00:00Z' AND '2026-06-14T15:01:00Z';
```
Rhea: Found 12 customers where billed_amount > 0 and posted_ts within 1s of release_ts. Two are reserved contracts (Finance: exclude), ten are consumption and need credits.
MarketplaceEng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-hold/pull/824 fixes millis normalization and adds integr tests. Will deploy hotfix to staging.
Oliver: InfraOps: can you run a one-off job to apply hold tag to the ten consumption customers and queue credit transactions?
BillingBot: Recommended steps:
1) Snapshot affected ledger_lines and upload CSV to partner record
2) Apply hold tag and set billing_disabled=true for those accounts
3) Queue credits equal to billed_amount and mark invoices for adjustment
4) Run end-to-end test in staging then prod in maintenance window
Rhea: I'll prepare partner-facing note: "Small boundary issue during embargo release; no customers were billed net-of-credit. We're applying credits now and fixing the edge-case."
LegalBot: Please include the timing of remediation and confirm reserved contracts were untouched.
Samir: Hotfix deployed to prod at 2026-06-15T02:30:00Z. Boundary test included.
Oliver: One-off job executed: holds applied, credits queued for 10 customers. Finance ticket FIN-9123 created.
BillingBot: Closed loop: 10 credits queued, 2 reserved accounts verified excluded. Net exposure reversed.
Rhea: Thanks all. Action items: MarketplaceEng (monitor for similar boundary events), Samir (merge test into CI), Finance (approve credits), Legal (archive audit). I'll close thread after Finance confirms credits posted. :thumbsup:
